title: "Installation"

# Create an environment

To avoid possible dependency conflicts, we recommend installing Reactix in a dedicated environment or to use [Pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev) to create a workspace for your project. Reactix requires Python 3.11 or later.

::: panel-tabset
## pixi

Start a new Pixi workspace:

``` bash
pixi init my_reactix_workspace
```

where `my_reactix_workspace` should be the name of your project using Reactix.

## conda

Create and activate a new conda environment:

``` bash
conda create -n reactix
conda activate reactix
```

To avoid issues with conda packages from multiple channels, we recommend to set a strict channel priority and set the `conda-forge` channel as the top of the channel list in your `.condarc`. See the [Tips & Trick page](https://conda-forge.org/docs/user/tipsandtricks/#using-multiple-channels) of conda-forge for instructions.

## uv

Create and activate an environment:

``` bash
uv venv reactix-env
source reactix-env/bin/activate  # Linux/macOS
reactix-env\Scripts\activate     # Windows
```

## venv

Create and activate an environment:

``` bash
python -m venv reactix-env
source reactix-env/bin/activate   # Linux/macOS
reactix-env\Scripts\activate      # Windows
```
:::

Activate the environment before installing the package.

# Install Reactix

To install the package you can use pixi, conda, pip or uv. The package is available on PyPI and conda-forge. Reactix depends on [JAX](https://jax.readthedocs.io) and [diffrax](https://docs.kidger.site/diffrax/). These are installed automatically when installing Reactix via pixi, pip, uv, or conda.

::: {.panel-tabset group="package-manager"}
## pixi

This will install Reactix from conda-forge.

``` bash
pixi add reactix
```

## conda

This will install Reactix from conda-forge.

``` bash
conda install -c conda-forge reactix
```

## uv

This will install Reactix from PyPI.

``` bash
uv pip install reactix
```

## pip

This will install Reactix from PyPI.

``` bash
pip install reactix
```
:::

# Additional dependencies

## Bayesian modeling with PyMC

For Bayesian modeling, Reactix can be coupled with [PyMC](https://www.pymc.io). To install the additionally required dependencies alongside Reactix:

::: {.panel-tabset group="package-manager"}
## pixi

``` bash
pixi add reactix[pymc]
```

## conda

``` bash
conda install -c conda-forge reactix pymc arviz nutpie
```

## uv

``` bash
uv pip install reactix[pymc]
```

## pip

``` bash
pip install reactix[pymc]
```
:::

## Running examples

Running the Jupyter notebook examples in the notebooks folder requires additional dependencies. You can install them as follows:

::: {.panel-tabset group="package-manager"}
## pixi

``` bash
pixi add reactix[notebooks]
```

## conda

``` bash
conda install -c conda-forge reactix ipympl ipykernel matplotlib
```

## uv

``` bash
uv pip install reactix[notebooks]
```

## pip

``` bash
pip install reactix[notebooks]
```
:::

## JAX and GPU support

GPU support integration is considered for a future release. Currently, Reactix can only be used with CPU-based JAX installations.
